module: Flowgraph node "Stars Active" (category repeat_instant, tags activity/mission). Each custom flow output pin (pin name = star key) lets the flow through if the corresponding star is active for the mission's current user settings (gameplay_missions_missionScreen.getActiveStarsForUserSettings). The list is computed only once (expensive) then cached until the next graph start. Without input flow, all pins are false.
notes: Without an associated activity, does nothing. A key absent from starInfo gives false (self.activeStars[pin.name] tested beforehand).

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the cache of active stars.

work.desc: Computes (once) starInfo then sets each flow output pin to the enabled value of the corresponding star.
